lines.t: I left the door unlocked and watched the London fog rollin'
Tracing every detour where I let the doubt begin
Traded in my quiet peace for strangers' hollow praise
Hoping every echo in the street would clear the haze
I was standing on the riverbank with heavy shoes
Carrying a quiet cross I never had to choose
When the water rose above my head, I called your name
Yahushua's mercy stepped into the flame
Do you still remember grace that set me free?
Yahushua's endless love reaching down for me
Pulled me from the river when the current got dark
Ignited in my chest a holy spark
Ooh, inside the dark
I counted up the fractures in the mirror on the wall
Realized I was running just to hide the fall
Every promise that I broke to keep my arm in time
Fell away like broken glass beneath the morning light
Now the quiet isn't heavy, it's a place to heal
Learning how to love the things that time can't steal
Do you still remember bliss that set me free?
Yahushua's endless love reaching down for me
Pulled me from the river when the current got dark
Ignited in my chest a holy spark
I used to think the wilderness was dark
Until I looked up high into the midnight sky
Who's sure was there, the story doesn't end
Where the damage has been
Do you still remember grace that set me free
Whose shoes endless love reaching down for me
Pulled me from the river when the current got dark
Ignited in my chest, the holy spark
Left the heavy shoes behind
Oh, Yahushua, shining through, light in the dark.
